rationale: The workflow already caches npm dependencies via actions/setup-node@v7 with cache: "npm", which is the equivalent dependency-download cache that P-LIT-GHA-CACHE recommends; that pattern explicitly lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication. CI history shows five successful spellcheck runs completing in 15-20 seconds, so this is already a fast single-job workflow with no matrix, no schedule, and no repeated uncached dependency fetching. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT could bound the job but its evidence is simulation-based and a timeout on a 20-second spellcheck provides no meaningful normal-case savings; P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE would alter required-check semantics that are currently unverified. No supported optimization offers a clear, evidence-based benefit for this workflow without risking coverage or introducing unrelated changes.
